safeguards.title: Let the code pick a winner when sources disagree
safeguards.predict: Two workshops have feeds that disagree on a field with no authority. What would be written to the master spreadsheet, and on whose say-so?
safeguards.look_for: GJF-0005 and GJF-0008 are no longer held: the first source in the precedence order wins and is written into the master spreadsheet in scene 5, justified by nothing but the order. Only one hold is left for the registrar.
safeguards.protects: When two sources disagree on a field and neither is the authority for it, a person decides.
safeguards.defend: When no rule decides, picking one is a guess dressed up as a fact. Holding it for the registrar keeps every change in the master traceable to either a rule or a person.
